title: Forró Já
subtitle: Regional Cultural Hub & Mobile-First PWA with AI-Powered Ingestion
summary: Cultural hub and mobile-first PWA for regional events with atomic RPC counters, observability, and a hybrid AI ingestion pipeline for flyers via Ollama and Gemini.
overview: Forró Já is a high-performance Progressive Web App (PWA) tailored for regional live events and cultural discovery. Built mobile-first for fluid WhatsApp sharing, it integrates a Supabase PostgreSQL backend, atomic RPC counters, and an AI-driven backoffice ingestion engine that extracts event schedules from flyer images using both local Ollama models and cloud Gemini APIs.
responsibilities: Designed reactive architecture following the rigorous AI Engineering Framework v2.1.
Built full-stack React 19, Vite 8, and Supabase integration with database-first type generation.
Implemented hybrid AI ingestion pipelines using local Ollama (qwen2.5-coder) and Gemini API for unstructured flyer parsing.
Configured automated Netlify CI/CD with diff logic, incremental TypeScript compilation, and offline PWA capabilities.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Eliminating type drift between frontend TypeScript interfaces and PostgreSQL schema.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Enforced a strict database-as-source-of-truth policy by integrating automated type generation (npm run typegen) directly into the CI pipeline.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Handling high-concurrency race conditions on attendee counter increments during peak traffic.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented atomic database increments using PostgreSQL Remote Procedure Calls (RPC increment_attendees).
